title: arhiiv
description: Estonian jewellery art archive: 472 artists, works, exhibitions, museum holdings, source-cited press
summary: Estonian jewellery art archive: 472 artists, works, exhibitions, museum holdings, source-cited press
offersHint: Estonian jewellery art archive: 472 artists, works, exhibitions, museum holdings, source-cited press · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://ehtekunst.ee/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_artists
toolsPreview.description: Search the artist registry by name, school, and/or graduation-year range. Returns paginated artist cards with work/exhibition counts and canonical page URLs. Estonian jewellery/metalwork artists.

toolsPreview.name: get_artist
toolsPreview.description: Get one artist by slug: biography, education, materials, linked-data (MuIS/Wikidata), knowledge-graph relations, and verified press mentions. Includes links.html for citation.

toolsPreview.name: search_works
toolsPreview.description: Search jewellery works/objects by title, artist, material, year range, or for-sale status. Returns paginated work cards (artist, year, materials, thumbnail, canonical URL).

toolsPreview.name: get_work
toolsPreview.description: Get one work by slug: description, dimensions, materials/techniques, images, museum holder, exhibitions it appeared in, price when for sale, and graph relations.

toolsPreview.name: search_exhibitions
toolsPreview.description: Search the exhibition database by title, year, or organizer. Returns paginated exhibition cards (title, dates, venue, city, canonical URL).

toolsPreview.name: get_exhibition
toolsPreview.description: Get one exhibition by slug: description, curator, organizers, participating artists, works shown, and verified press reception.

toolsPreview.name: get_organization
toolsPreview.description: Get one organization by slug (school, gallery, museum, association): description, linked-data, exhibition count, and graph relations.

toolsPreview.name: get_relations
toolsPreview.description: Walk the knowledge graph around an entity: teachers and students (STUDIED_UNDER), exhibition participation, museum holdings (HELD_BY), memberships, awards. entity_type ∈ artist|work|exhibition|organization. Every edge carries its source citation and the target's URL.

toolsPreview.name: search_press
toolsPreview.description: Find press and publication sources (Estonian newspapers via DEA, monographs) in a year range, optionally filtered by a text query against the source title/publication. Backed by the archive timeline.

toolsPreview.name: search_marks
toolsPreview.description: Search historical Estonian goldsmiths' maker's marks (monograms/letters) by lettering, town, or century. Returns marks with the attributed master (when known), town, active years, and the citing source. Audience: collectors and antique dealers as well as researchers.

toolsPreview.name: get_timeline
toolsPreview.description: The archive in one query: merged, year-sorted events (graduations, exhibitions, press, publications) between two years. Great for a chronological overview of Estonian jewellery art.

toolsPreview.name: get_stats
toolsPreview.description: Archive-wide published counts (artists, works, exhibitions, organizations, articles, sources), year coverage, and last-updated timestamp.
